rows.ja: サプライヤー(クラウド基盤)

relations.text: AppianはAmazon Web Servicesと、最低購入コミットメント条項付きの解約不能なクラウドホスティング契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Appian has a non-cancellable cloud hosting arrangement with Amazon Web Services that contains provisions for minimum purchase commitments

source.label: Appian 10-K
source.quote: We have a non-cancellable cloud hosting arrangement with Amazon Web Services (“AWS”) that contains provisions for minimum purchase commitments.

relations.text: AppianがAmazon Web Servicesと戦略的協業契約を結び、生成AIを企業の業務プロセスに広げる
relations.text_en: Appian signed a Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Amazon Web Services to make generative AI more accessible to enterprise business processes

source.label: Appian の発表
source.quote: Appian (Nasdaq: APPN) announced today that it has signed a Strategic Collaboration Agreement (SCA) with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to make generative artificial intelligence (AI) more accessible to enterprise business processes.

relations.text: Appianの戦略的パートナーの1社で、顧客にAppianのソフトウェア購入を紹介できる
relations.text_en: A strategic partner of Appian that can refer customers to it to purchase software subscriptions

source.label: Appian 10-K
source.quote: We also have several strategic partnerships, including with Accenture, Capgemini, Deloitte, Indra Group, KPMG, and PwC, which allow them to refer customers to us in order to purchase software subscriptions.

relations.text: AppianはAccentureと戦略的パートナーシップを結ぶ
relations.text_en: Appian has a strategic partnership with Accenture.

source.label: Appian 10-K
source.quote: We have a number of strategic partnerships with companies, including Accenture, Capgemini, Deloitte, Indra Group, KPMG, and PwC.

relations.text: AppianがAccentureのINTIENTパートナー網にコアパートナーとして加わった
relations.text_en: Appian joined Accenture's INTIENT partner ecosystem as a core partner

source.label: Appian の発表
source.quote: Appian (NASDAQ: APPN) today announced that it has joined Accenture’s INTIENT partner ecosystem as a core partner.

relations.text: AppianがSnowflakeとの技術提携を始め、AppianのデータファブリックをSnowflakeのAI Data Cloudにつなぐ

relations.text: AppianがGuidewire PartnerConnectにSelectレベルのソリューションパートナーとして加わった
relations.text_en: Appian joined Guidewire PartnerConnect as a Solution partner at the Select level

source.label: Appian の発表
source.quote: Guidewire (NYSE: GWRE) and Appian (Nasdaq: APPN) today announced that Appian has joined Guidewire PartnerConnect as a new Solution partner at the Select level.

source.quote: Appian (NASDAQ: APPN) today announced an integration partnership with Box, a leading cloud content management platform, to make enterprise collaboration more efficient, secure, and valuable.
